responsibility: Defines the target type macros GCC uses to synthesize <stdint.h> for DragonFly systems. It maps exact-width, least-width, fast-width, pointer-sized, and sig_atomic_t types to DragonFly ABI-appropriate C type spellings, with LONG_TYPE_SIZE-dependent selection for 64-bit types. This header is purely about stdint type model definitions, not driver specs or OS builtins.
